change: Installer stops with a non-zero result when the existing uninstaller fails. Acceptance verifies the old application payload and user data remain available after failed uninstall-first, and covers six data files across settings, subscriptions, cloud accounts, history, and favorites.

verification.oldUninstallerFailureRollback: PASS: prior payload and all six user-data files restored/preserved

limitations: Process-stop fixture is a headless timer process, not Win-Box while playing or hidden by boss-key.
